title: Create Double Tap
description: A modpack with create and other vannila + mods
body:
This is a Create And Vannila + Modpack.
Wich aims to combine the longevity of vannila minecraft and the creative solutions Create offers.
This modpack has a variety of Create addons such as Create: Enchantment industry, Create Garnished & many more.

It also has a couple of quality of life mods such as curios and inventory sorting mods.
